newsitem.title: UK: DMG to return to London equities - paper.
newsitem.headline: DMG to return to London equities - paper.

text.p: Deutsche Morgan Grenfell (DMG) is set to return to the UK equity market next week, eight years after withdrawing from the London market, said the Independent on Sunday newspaper.

The report said DMG, the investment banking arm of Germany's Deutsche bank, will activate its Stock Exchange membership next week in preparation for fullscale trading in London equities and plans to build a team of 75 analysts and salesmen.
The Independent said the move coincides with the Deutsche Telekom AG float, giving DMG the opportunity to make a market in Deutsche Telekom shares.

DMG's parent company Deutsche Bank is one of the global coordinators for the flotation. The first tranche of Deutsche Telekom is due to be sold off on November 18 in what will be Europe's biggest ever flotation.
